summary: pickup.c:pickup runs pickup_object() in source order, and pickup_object() lets lift_object() print the full-pack refusal and return -1. JavaScript preflightPickupObjects() instead throws UnsupportedPickupError when its projected ordinary-slot count reaches 52, before pickup_object() and lift_object() run. The planner should leave the failing item to the source lift path so pickup can emit the message and stop its loop.

source.branch: During pickup, a selected non-gold floor object that cannot merge when inv_cnt(FALSE) is at least invlet_basic reaches lift_object(). lift_object() prints the knapsack message and returns -1; pickup() breaks from the selected-item loop after pickup_object() returns that value.
callers: nethack-c/upstream/src/hack.c:dopickup:3876-3891 calls pickup(-count) for the comma command; cmd.c dispatches that command through dopickup().
js/hack.js:dopickup() calls pickup(-count, state), which reaches preflightPickupObjects() before the matching pickup_object() loop.
dependencies: pickup_object() and lift_object() already implement the source full-pack refusal in js/pickup.js; this fix only changes when the existing source path runs.

evidence: The saved accepted v56 evaluation at cb8de9975a5fd4c4016df9ae7aebb1a7d42856ec records 2187/2208 screens, 2621/2628 RNG calls, 2187/2208 cursors, and error null. Its first mismatch is step 2187 with an unsupported pickup: pickup() with a full pack. The immutable recording SHA is 54655f8a140ae0b161c4d0a8c3afb5909242c45ba0938d669a99750a6008f9d1; manifest SHA is a05e102b18a6c939cbe407c82a83d058037489ba53df8cab9ee52a2568727d74.

A fresh JavaScript replay at 6976a138e80ace5926bfcb953159cb53b64222bd reproduces the queue totals: .cache/Cv56-full-pack-before.log reports 2187/2208 screens, 2621/2628 RNG calls, 2187/2208 cursors, and no runner error.

The selected C recording shows the user selecting the two white gem objects with a full inventory. At step 2187, C prints “Your knapsack cannot accommodate any more items.” The JavaScript replay stops at the same input boundary with UnsupportedPickupError before this message path runs.

Upstream pickup.c:783-788 and :841-910 call pickup_object() in menu and traditional loops and break when it returns a negative result. pickup.c:1869-1871 returns lift_object() results from pickup_object(). pickup.c:1740-1753 prints the full-pack message and sets result to -1 after carry_count() succeeds but before pick_obj() or addinv().

JavaScript js/pickup.js:1061-1075 throws from preflightPickupObjects() when projectedSlots reaches 52 and the next plan adds an ordinary slot. This runs before js/pickup.js:1170-1182 automatic selection and before the commit loop at :1290 onward. The already implemented lift_object() at :2905-2977 matches the C full-pack condition and message.

The correction belongs in the preflight planner: preserve plans for earlier accepted items, but leave the first projected non-merge addition that exceeds the source limit without an addinv plan. C’s live lift_object() then rejects it and pickup() stops the loop in source order. The fix must also preserve the shop exception, where billing can change mergeability.
